title: Datacenter and crawler clicks counted as human
class_symptom: A bot filter that looks only at the User-Agent counts every crawler or link scanner that sends a browser User-Agent as a human click.
mechanism: ADR-019 classifies bots by UA string alone; scanners and preview fetchers on datacenter networks present ordinary browser UAs, so they pass as non-bot visitors.

evidence: Offline ASN lookup of stored click IPs on prod: 306 of 673 non-bot clicks came from datacenter or crawler networks.
Partner-direct: 220 of 422. Referral: 86 of 251. India home/mobile networks: 326.
Top networks: Facebook, Hetzner, WHG, Apple AS714, OVH, Hostinger, Google Cloud, Brandwatch.

measurements: 673 non-bot clicks classified by ASN of the stored click IP: 306 datacenter/crawler, 326 India home/mobile (remainder unclassified).
Split by link type: partner-direct 220/422 datacenter, referral 86/251 datacenter.

detection.check: Context, the fix (not a recurrence detector): PR #198 apps/events/netranges.py classifies known datacenter ranges on the live click path, and the reclassify_datacenter_clicks command repairs stored rows. Merged as 844e3f8.
detection.reason: fix covers known networks; no detector flags a new crawler network passing as human (e.g. a periodic report of non-bot clicks from hosting ASNs not in the table)
